name: MUSDB18: A Corpus for Music Source Separation
description: MUSDB18 is a multitrack music dataset comprising 150 full-length music songs (~10 hours total audio) designed for evaluating music source separation algorithms. Each track includes isolated vocals, drums, bass, and accompaniment stems alongside full stereophonic mixtures encoded in uncompressed and STEMS format.
